name: Machinify (2nd role)
desc:
Document Specialist | $15.00/hr | Data Entry/Admin, No Sales Expectations
Company: Machinify
Industry: Healthcare Technology / Claims Processing
What Your Day Will Look Like:
 Think of yourself as the quality control checkpoint for a big pile of medical claims paperwork. You'd process and review incoming documents, make sure everything is organized and routed to the right place, and catch errors before they become bigger problems. A lot of your day is data entry, reconciling balances, checking charges, and keeping file systems accurate, plus flagging any tech issues you run into along the way. It's detail heavy, behind the scenes work that keeps the whole claims process running smoothly, without a lot of phone or customer facing time.
assessment: Expect a basic assessment, a typing test, and a home internet speed test, since the posting doesn't state otherwise.
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements
 Education Minimum: Not specified in the posting
Required Experience: Not strictly required, though a healthcare background is preferred
Preferred Experience: Healthcare industry background
Required Skills:
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and Adobe Acrobat
Comfort working across multi-monitor setups and learning company-specific software
Strong attention to detail
Excellent organizational, analytical, and critical thinking abilities
Best Fit
 This role is ideal for:
Someone who genuinely enjoys detail-heavy, behind-the-scenes work over phone-based customer service
Someone with a healthcare or medical billing background, or a strong interest in breaking into healthcare tech
Someone comfortable managing multiple screens and systems at once
Someone who is naturally organized and catches small errors before they become big ones
Not a Good Fit for
Anyone who wants a role centered on talking with people rather than processing documents
Anyone who needs a higher hourly rate right out of the gate, since this one starts at $15
Anyone who struggles with sustained, detail-focused screen work
Top 10 Resume Keywords:
Document processing
Claims review
Data entry
Healthcare administration
Quality assurance
Microsoft Office Suite
Adobe Acrobat
Attention to detail
File management
Reconciliation
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
Application
Expect an assessment at the end of the application or directly emailed to you
If the assessment is passing, expect a recruiter to reach out via email or text for a phone screen
If the phone screen passes, expect a final interview
Total time to hire from date of application can be anywhere from 3 to 15 days on average.
4-5 interview questions for this role:
Tell us about a time you caught an error in a document or dataset before it became a bigger issue.
How do you stay organized when managing a high volume of documents or claims at once?
Walk us through your comfort level with Microsoft Office and multi-monitor setups.
Describe a time you had to analyze data trends to spot a pattern or inefficiency.
What interests you about working in healthcare claims processing?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
Pay: $15.00 per hour, non-exempt
Shift: Not specified in the posting
Benefits: PTO, paid holidays, and volunteer days, health, vision, and dental coverage, 401(k) with company match, flexible spending accounts, tuition reimbursement, life insurance, short-term disability, and parental leave
Equipment Provided: Not specified in the posting, and no internet requirement is listed either. Confirm both during the recruiter screen
Felony Friendly?: Not stated
Drug Test: Not stated
Notes: This is a nice fit for a participant who wants a quieter, detail-driven role behind a computer rather than a phone-heavy customer service job, and it's a genuine foot in the door with a healthcare technology company that has strong benefits like tuition reimbursement. The posting is transparent about growth, laying out what success looks like at 3 months and 1 year, which is a nice thing to point out to a participant who wants to see a real path forward.
Career Pathway: Document Specialist → Senior Document Specialist → Claims Analyst or Quality Assurance Specialist
